k:時.mnemonic: The day (日) at the temple (寺). Temples rang the bells that told everyone the time. Time.

k:巾.mnemonic: A towel hanging over a rail, with the two ends dangling. Towel.

k:市.mnemonic: A lid (亠) over a towel (巾). Under a lid and on a towel is how every stall lays out its goods at the market, and where the market is, a city grows. City.

k:後.mnemonic: You stroll (彳) along, but a tiny (幺) thing makes you trudge (夂). Now you are behind everyone else. Behind (and after).

k:東.mnemonic: The day's sun (日) rising up behind a tree (木). The sun rises in the east.

k:今.mnemonic: A hat (𠆢) with one (一) line and a little hook under it: the hat is being pulled down right now. Now.

k:合.mnemonic: Now (今) a mouth (口) opens under the hat. The hat fits, the mouth fits, everything fits: suit (and fit, join, combine).

k:長.mnemonic: An old person with long hair streaming down, leaning on a stick. Long hair, long life, and the eldest is the chief. Long.

k:気.mnemonic: Vapor (气) with a slide (ノ) and a drop (丶) inside: steam rising off a bowl of rice. That warm energy in the air is spirit (energy, mood, air).

k:自.mnemonic: A nose seen from the front. When people in Japan point to themselves they point at their nose. Self.

k:前.mnemonic: A month (月) and a knife (刂) under a pair of horns. The butcher's stall with knives and horns is always at the front of the market. Front (and before).
k:前.hint: Knife and horns at the front stall.

k:斤.mnemonic: An axe with its blade on the left and the handle on the right. Axe.

k:新.mnemonic: Stand (立) a tree (木) up and take an axe (斤) to it. Fresh-cut wood is new. New.

k:了.mnemonic: A child (子) with the arms missing: the swaddling is finished and the baby is tucked in. Done, complete.

k:可.mnemonic: A mouth (口) with a hook (了-shaped) around it: the mouth says 'yes, you can'. Can (possible, approve).

k:事.mnemonic: You can (可) do it, but only with a broom (ヨ) stuck through the middle. Sweeping up is the matter at hand. Matter (thing, affair).

k:万.mnemonic: One (一) line with a stick and a slide hanging off it: a swastika-like ancient sign for a huge number. Ten thousand.
k:万.hint: An ancient sign for a huge number.

k:作.mnemonic: A leader (亻) with ten thousand (万) workers. Give a leader ten thousand hands and they can make anything. Make.

k:米.mnemonic: A grain of rice in the middle with husks flying off in every direction after threshing. Rice.

k:来.mnemonic: Rice (米) growing on a tree (木)? That would be amazing; everyone would come to see it. Come.
k:来.hint: Everyone comes to see the rice tree.
